items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Thursday, 02 July 2026 at 5:00am by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Strong winds.


##Synopsis##

Low pressure in the North Sea as high pressure to the southwest builds a ridge over the area.


##Wind##

West or northwest 5 or 6, occasionally 7 at first, decreasing mainly 3 or 4 early afternoon, but remaining 5 occasionally 6 in the north and far east of the area. Further decreasing 3 or 4 in all waters later.


##State of Sea##

Moderate occasionally rough at first, falling slight occasionally moderate this afternoon.


##Weather##

Mainly fair.


##Visibility##

Good.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

West or northwest 2 to 4, backing south or southwest 4 or 5, occasionally 6 later.


##State of Sea##

Slight occasionally moderate later.


##Weather##

Fair.


##Visibility##

Good.
